text: Free demo: you run a tiny forge, and your raw material is garbage.
A customer asks for a hammer. You dig through the bin, put an old phone on the anvil, and hit it.
Out comes a hammer with chattering teeth. There are over ten thousand combinations like that.
Best part: the customers. A robot, a medusa, a two-faced man, and one fluffy guy who pays with a giant cookie.
Then a portal opens over your trash can and dumps a mountain of junk on the floor.
The catch? The crafting itself is one timing bar. Hit it in the right zone, that's it.
It's tiny, about three hundred megabytes, in twelve languages.
Think Potion Craft, if the potions were cursed junk.
Worth a dip. One hammer, twenty bucks.
